name: Warm Blue
lede: Warm Blue is a saturated, slightly purplish blue from the xkcd color survey of 2010, built by stacking the modifier "warm" onto the base color [[blue]].

sections.title: A modifier, not a story
sections.body:
The name follows the same modifier grammar as other xkcd survey names: "warm" plus the base word [[blue]], rather than a plant, place or person [1]. The ISCC-NBS 1955 system's nearest block for this swatch is strong purplish blue, about seven units from that block's center, so the name and the official chip category do not quite agree on how purple the color reads [1].

Its closest measured look-alikes are [[majorelle-blue|Majorelle Blue]] and a Dark Periwinkle pair, both read as duller or almost the same [1]. [[electric-blue|Electric Blue]] sits further out, read as more vivid [1].

sections.title: Field notes
sections.body: No painting in our 23,781-painting archive has this color covering at least one percent of its canvas, as photographed [2]. That describes this archive, not painting as a whole: a 2010 crowd-survey name has no reason to match an old painter's palette, and our collection's early centuries are thin to begin with [2].
